title: Capital Plan Schedule — Retirement, Revolvement and Redemption Terms of the Member Equities & Patronage Classes
content:
Under the capital plan of Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit, every retirement, revolvement or redemption of Member Equities & Patronage requires board approval. This schedule gives, for each class, when it is retired, how long payment takes, whether part of a balance may be retired, the notice and remaining-balance terms for redemptions, and the board's revolvement target.

## Terms by class

| | Class C Participation Certificate | Class A Nonvoting Common Stock | Class B Voting Stock | Qualified Allocated Surplus | Nonqualified Allocated Surplus | Class H Preferred Stock |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The class is retired once the member has no open loan | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Retirement on request requires that the member has no loan in any open status | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No | No |
| Calendar days after the retirement request (or the last loan payoff, for automatic retirements) within which an approved retirement is paid | 60 | 60 | 60 | 0 | 0 | 30 |
| Every retirement, revolvement or redemption requires board approval | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Part of the balance may be retired while the rest stays outstanding | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Calendar days of written notice required before a redemption takes effect (0 = not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 |
| Smallest balance that may remain after a partial redemption (USD; 0 = not applicable) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1000 |
| Target years between allocation and board revolvement of an allocation year (0 = not revolved) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 5 | 10 | 0 |

## Points of the schedule

- Borrower equity — the Class C Participation Certificate, Class A Nonvoting Common Stock and Class B Voting Stock — is retired whole, never in part, and is tied to the member's loans.
- Allocated surplus is revolved by allocation year: the board's target is 5 years for Qualified Allocated Surplus and 10 years for Nonqualified Allocated Surplus.
- Class H Preferred Stock is redeemed on 30 calendar days' written notice, may be redeemed in part, and the smallest balance that may remain after a partial redemption is USD 1000.
